item.title: Habitat Network — Fen source files
item.subtitle: Biodiversity & Habitats / Ulster Wildlife
item.description: Spatial extent of fen habitat across Northern Ireland, classified into Existing Habitat, Associated Habitats, Network Enhancement Zones, Fragmentation Action Zones and Network Expansion Zones. Part of the Nature Recovery NI habitat-network mapping project published by Ulster Wildlife on Open Data NI.
